body:
If you want both of these tools to initialize/preserve their hooks, it's way better to set 2 seperate if checks for each tool (bash_preexec and BLE respectively) instead of chaining them together (check if BLE, and else check if bash_preexec then - what sense does that make?). Sure, most people don't have both BLE and bash_preexec installed but it's still a likely occurence.

Also I added `! ([[ "${preexec_functions[@]}" =~ "starship_preexec_all" ]] || [[ "${precmd_functions[@]}" =~ "starship_precmd" ]])` to the condition that checks for bash_preexec since I noticed that the bash_preexec function array `preexec_functions` had multiple `starship_preexec_all`'s after having resourced ~/.bashrc a few times. (even though they could be shortened)
